steps.title: Our stock in three hospitals

steps.title: Who else makes it

steps.finding: 6 labelers make it in this form.

steps.title: What FDA found at those plants

steps.finding: 61 inspections (12 OAI at our plants), 5 compliance actions, 1 import-alert listings, 0 recalls.

steps.title: What FDA wrote at the OAI inspections
steps.purpose: Read the Form 483 observations recorded at those inspections.

steps.title: What our P&T committee already approved
steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

steps.title: Which links can't be trusted
steps.purpose: Run the semantic layer's key rules (NDC and unit of use) over each hospital's stock, and name the rows they reject.
steps.finding: 11 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 0 of them are this drug. Every row is in a shared unit of use.

steps.title: What we decided last time
steps.purpose: Recall past decisions on this drug from H-MEM, with who approved them.
steps.finding: No past decisions on this drug.

explanation.headline: FDA's records show a warning letter at Hospira, Inc., a plant on our labels, 265 days before the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the dobutamine hydrochloride shortage on 2017-11-06 and it remains Current as of 2026-10-21.
The product labels for the Baxter Healthcare Corporation bags used at Corvale General and Corvale East name Baxter Healthcare Corporation as the registered plant (FEI 1416980).
FDA inspection 1031233 at that plant ended 2017-10-27 and was classified VAI, 10 days before the shortage posting.
The same plant received an OAI classification after an inspection that ended 2026-04-02, with a Warning Letter issued 2026-09-29.
Hospira, Inc. (a Pfizer Company) is also listed as Current on the FDA shortage list for dobutamine hydrochloride.
Corvale East has 3.1 days of 100 mg/100 mL bags on hand while Corvale General has 25 days.
The rule‑ranked option is to transfer 57 bags of 100 mg/100 mL, 250 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would give Corvale East 14 days and leave Corvale General with 16 days.
